title: Ambient Lighting Edit Unlocked Palette
descriptionHtml:
✓ Vegan✓ Alcohol Free✓ Gluten Free✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Without Parabens✓ Without Sulfates SLS & SLES

What it is: A limited-edition face palette with new Ambient Lighting shades for a lit-from-within glow, featuring charms by French designer Lauren Rubinski.


Ingredient Callouts: Free of parabens, phthalates, mineral oil, sulfates SLS & SLES, and triclosan. These products are also vegan and cruelty-free.


What Else You Need to Know: Five percent of net profits from Unlocked support the Nonhuman Rights Project. This palette features everything you need to diffuse, enhance, and add glow in a single compact  It features five brand-new shades and limited-edition packaging by French jewelry designer Lauren Rubinski.

How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Pair with the Ambient Lighting Edit Brush and Ambient Lighting Edit Brush II (each sold separately) for the most flawless finish. 
-FINISH: Using the rounded end of Ambient Lighting Edit Brush, dust Ambient Lighting Powder all over the face to diffuse and enhance the complexion.
-BRONZE: Using the slanted end of the Ambient Lighting Edit Brush, brush bronzer along the temples, hollows of the cheeks, and jawline for warmth and definition.
-BLUSH: Use the slanted end of Ambient Lighting Edit Brush II, apply Ambient Lighting Blush to the apples of the cheek.
-HIGHLIGHT: Using the tapered end of the Ambient Lighting Edit Brush II, apply Strobe Lighting Powder to the high points of the face: the top of cheeks, bridge of nose, and brow bone.
Ingredients+
Soft Dahlia:
Mica, Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Boron Nitride, Octyldodecanol, Hdi/Trimethylol Hexyllactone Crosspolymer, Polymethyl Methacrylate, Dimethicone, Polymethylsilsesquioxane, Trimethylsiloxysilicate, Sorbic Acid, Sodium Dehydroacetate, Magnesium Aluminum Silicate, Phenoxyethanol, Polyacrylamide, C13-14 Isoparaffin, Silica, Benzoic Acid, Laureth-7, Dehydroacetic Acid, Potassium Sorbate, Ethylhexylglycerin, Diamond Powder, Sorbitan Sesquioleate, Alumina, Red 7 Lake (Ci 15850), Bismuth Oxychloride (Ci 77163), Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, Ci 77492, Ci 77499), Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891).

Mica, Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Boron Nitride, Octyldodecanol, Hdi/Trimethylol Hexyllactone Crosspolymer, Polymethyl Methacrylate, Dimethicone, Polymethylsilsesquioxane, Trimethylsiloxysilicate, Sorbic Acid, Sodium Dehydroacetate, Magnesium Aluminum Silicate, Phenoxyethanol, Polyacrylamide, C13-14 Isoparaffin, Silica, Benzoic Acid, Laureth-7, Dehydroacetic Acid, Potassium Sorbate, Ethylhexylglycerin, Diamond Powder, Sorbitan Sesquioleate, Alumina, Bismuth Oxychloride (Ci 77163), Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, Ci 77492, Ci 77499), Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891).

Eternal Light:
Mica, Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Boron Nitride, Octyldodecanol, Hdi/Trimethylol Hexyllactone Crosspolymer, Polymethyl Methacrylate, Dimethicone, Polymethylsilsesquioxane, Trimethylsiloxysilicate, Magnesium Aluminum Silicate, Phenoxyethanol, Sorbic Acid, Polyacrylamide, Sodium Dehydroacetate, C13-14 Isoparaffin, Benzoic Acid, Laureth-7, Silica, Dehydroacetic Acid, Potassium Sorbate, Ethylhexylglycerin, Diamond Powder, Sorbitan Sesquioleate, Yellow 5 Lake (Ci 19140), Bismuth Oxychloride (Ci 77163), Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, Ci 77492, Ci 77499), Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891).

Orchid Flush:
Mica, Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Boron Nitride, Octyldodecanol, Hdi/Trimethylol Hexyllactone Crosspolymer, Polymethyl Methacrylate, Dimethicone, Polymethylsilsesquioxane, Trimethylsiloxysilicate, Sorbic Acid, Sodium Dehydroacetate, Magnesium Aluminum Silicate, Phenoxyethanol, Polyacrylamide, Calcium Sodium Borosilicate, C13-14 Isoparaffin, Tin Oxide, Benzoic Acid, Silica, Laureth-7, Dehydroacetic Acid, Potassium Sorbate, Ethylhexylglycerin, Diamond Powder, Sorbitan Sesquioleate, Alumina, Yellow 5 Lake (Ci 19140), Red 7 Lake (Ci 15850), Yellow 6 Lake (Ci 15985), Red 28 Lake (Ci 45410), Bismuth Oxychloride (Ci 77163), Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, Ci 77499), Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891).

Radiant Mauve:
Mica, Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Alumina, Boron Nitride, Octyldodecanol, Hdi/Trimethylol Hexyllactone Crosspolymer, Polymethyl Methacrylate, Dimethicone, Polymethylsilsesquioxane, Trimethylsiloxysilicate, Sorbic Acid, Sodium Dehydroacetate, Magnesium Aluminum Silicate, Phenoxyethanol, Polyacrylamide, C13-14 Isoparaffin, Benzoic Acid, Silica, Laureth-7, Dehydroacetic Acid, Potassium Sorbate, Ethylhexylglycerin, Tin Oxide, Diamond Powder, Sorbitan Sesquioleate, Red 7 Lake (Ci 15850), Red 33 Lake (Ci 17200), Bismuth Oxychloride (Ci 77163), Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, Ci 77492, Ci 77499), Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891).
